CSCG.description: The CSCG is an annual German CTF competition that spans two months and serves as the qualifier for the DHM, where the German team for the ECSC is selected.

GPNCTF.description: GPNCTF is an annual CTF competition hosted by KITCTF at the GPN chaos computer club event in Karlsruhe.

SEKAICTF.description: SekaiCTF is an annual CTF competition, hosted by PROJECT SEKAI - a well-known international CTF team. The competition itself is known for its sizable prize pools and for serving as a prequalifier for events like MaltaCTF and XCTF.

DHM.description: The DHM is the annual CTF final round of the CSCG qualifiers, where teams of 6 members compete against each other for the chance to qualify for the ECSC.

KITCTF.description: KITCTF organizes the local IntroCTF @KIT every semester and the GPNCTF annually.

SMILEYCTF.description: SmileyCTF is hosted by "America's #1 CTF team" named .;,;.

UMDCTF.description: UMDCTF is an annual CTF competition hosted by the University of Maryland.

FCSC.description: The FCSC is the French equivalent of the CSCG/DHM and serves as the qualifier for selecting the French team for the ECSC.

EHAX.description: EHAX is an online 24-hour CTF competition hosted as part of Invictus DTU's mega tech fest in India.

LACTF.description: LACTF is an annual American CTF competition hosted by ACM Cyber at UCLA.

DVCTF.description: DVCTF is annually held by DaVinciCode, the academic team of the École supérieure d'ingénieurs Léonard-de-Vinci in France.
